channel.title: Gap Hunter Labs — new plugins
channel.description: New JetBrains plugins and VS Code extensions from Gap Hunter Labs, each built for a documented gap in developer tooling.

item.title: Postman OpenAPI Drift Companion
item.description: Warns when a Postman collection endpoint's method+path no longer exists in the project's OpenAPI/Swagger spec.

item.title: PHP Composer Script Companion
item.description: Flags an orphan composer.json script -- never called from itself, CI configs, or README.md.

item.title: Log Format String Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Code Quality / Logging
item.description: Flags a log call whose placeholder count doesn't match its argument count -- SLF4J {} and Python %-style format strings.

item.title: Semver Bump Mismatch Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · VCS / Git Workflow
item.description: Flags a CHANGELOG.md release that reads as a breaking change but didn't bump MAJOR.

item.title: SQL Concatenation Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · SQL Injection Detection
item.description: Finds SQL built by unparameterized string concatenation or interpolation, then executed, across Java/Kotlin/Python.

item.title: Ruby Companion
item.description: 3 turnkey Ruby checks in one extension: shell injection, Net::HTTP reuse in a loop, and ungrouped dev/test gems in Gemfile.

item.title: PHP Security Companion
item.description: 5 turnkey PHP injection-sink checks in one extension: SQL, shell, file inclusion, function injection, and open redirect.

item.title: Merge Conflict Leftover Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · VCS / Git Workflow
item.description: Finds leftover Git conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) accidentally committed in any file.

item.title: Circular Dependency Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Build Tooling / Architecture
item.description: Flags real circular dependencies between modules of a multi-module Gradle project -- 100% static text parsing, no Gradle daemon.

item.title: Cert Companion
item.description: Decodes X.509 certificates (PEM/CRT/CER/DER) inline -- subject, issuer, validity, fingerprint, right in the editor.

item.title: Wrangler Config Companion
item.description: Validates wrangler.toml -- required fields (name/main/compatibility_date), and missing bindings.

item.title: Unleash Flag Usage Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Feature Flag Tooling
item.description: Inventories Unleash feature flag usage across your codebase -- naming check, find-all-usages, stale-flag detection.

item.title: Turborepo Graph Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Build Tooling / Architecture
item.description: Shows your Turborepo workspace dependency graph as a sidebar tree -- parses turbo.json + package.json workspaces.

item.title: MLflow Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · ML / Data Tooling
item.description: Browses local MLflow tracking-store runs (params, metrics, tags) in a sidebar tree, reading the store directly.

item.title: Flaky Test History Companion
item.description: Tracks pass/fail history per test across JUnit XML report runs and flags tests with mixed outcomes.

item.title: Embedded Stack Usage Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Embedded / C Tooling
item.description: Parses GCC .su stack-usage files (-fstack-usage) and flags any function over a configurable stack budget.

item.title: Config Secrets File Companion
item.description: Flags a hardcoded secret (AWS key, GitHub/Slack token, JWT, PEM key, or high-entropy value) in config and env files.

item.title: Typosquat Dependency Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Supply Chain Security
item.description: Flags a package.json dependency whose name is a near-miss (edit distance 1-2) of a much more popular package.

item.title: Prometheus Alert Rule Companion
item.description: Lints Prometheus alert rule YAML -- duplicate alert names, missing 'for', missing annotations.

item.title: OAuth2/OIDC Flow Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · JWT / Auth Tooling
item.description: Builds and decodes OAuth2 authorization-code+PKCE URLs -- generates code_verifier/challenge pairs and decodes callback params.

item.title: Node Version Drift Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Node.js / npm Tooling
item.description: Flags when .nvmrc/.node-version/package.json engines.node/Dockerfile/CI disagree on the Node.js version.

item.title: N+1 Query Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · ORM / Query Tooling
item.description: Flags a TypeORM/Sequelize/Drizzle find/query call inside a loop -- the classic N+1 query pattern.

item.title: Dependency License Companion
item.description: Reads each node_modules dependency's SPDX license locally and flags copyleft or missing licenses.

item.title: CODEOWNERS Validator Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · VCS / Git Workflow
item.description: Validates a CODEOWNERS file -- duplicated patterns, unmatched patterns, invalid owners, syntax errors.

item.title: Webhook Signature Companion
item.description: Computes and verifies HMAC webhook signatures (GitHub/generic sha1/sha256/sha512) against a payload and secret.

item.title: Unreal UHT Macro Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · Game Dev / Unreal
item.description: Flags common UnrealHeaderTool macro mistakes in C++ headers: missing .generated.h include and related UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION issues.

item.title: Pact Contract Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · API Contract Testing
item.description: Lists consumer-provider Pact contract files in your workspace and flags interactions with no matching provider state.

item.title: JWT Companion
item.category: VS Code extension · JWT / Auth Tooling
item.description: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens on hover or via command -- no data leaves your editor.

item.title: Info.plist Usage Description Companion
item.description: Cross-checks Swift/Objective-C imports (CoreLocation, Contacts, Photos, etc.) against required Info.plist usage-description keys.

item.title: Cargo Audit Companion
item.description: Wraps cargo audit --json as inline VS Code diagnostics on Cargo.toml -- RustSec advisories at the exact dependency line.

item.title: Android Unused Permission Companion
item.description: Flags a permission declared in AndroidManifest.xml that no Kotlin/Java source actually uses.

item.title: gRPC Missing Deadline Companion
item.description: Warning on an RPC call made through a generated gRPC blocking stub (XxxGrpc.newBlockingStub(channel)....call(request)) whose stub-construction chain never passes through .withDeadline(...)/.withDeadlineAfter(...).

item.title: Unsafe Deserialization Sink Companion
item.description: Warning on a new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject() call inside a Spring MVC/JAX-RS endpoint method whose constructor argument traces back (within the same method, one direct hop) to an untrusted parameter -- CWE-502, Deserialization of Untrusted Data.

item.title: Terraform IAM Wildcard Companion
item.description: Warning on an IAM policy statement (inside a Terraform aws_iam_policy/aws_iam_role_policy resource's jsonencode({...}) block) whose Action or Resource is "*" with no Condition scoping it down.

item.title: SSRF via Unsanitized URL Companion
item.description: Warning on an HTTP call (HttpRequest.newBuilder(...)/Spring RestTemplate/OkHttp's Request.Builder) whose URL/host argument traces back (within the same method, one direct hop) to an untrusted Spring MVC/JAX-RS controller parameter, with no allowlist validation found in the same method -- CWE-918, Server-Side Request Forgery.

item.title: Retry Without Backoff+Jitter Companion
item.description: Warning on a retry mechanism with a FIXED interval between attempts instead of exponential backoff + jitter: a manual for/while retry loop that Thread.sleep(constant)s in its catch, Spring @Retryable with no real exponential @Backoff, or Resilience4j's RetryConfig built with a fixed .waitDuration(...) and no .intervalFunction(...).

item.title: Redis/Redisson Distributed Lock Missing TTL Companion
item.description: Warning on a SET ... NX call (Jedis's SetParams.nx()/Lettuce's SetArgs.Builder.nx() manual distributed-lock pattern) with no EX/PX expiry chained onto the same builder.

item.title: ReDoS Catastrophic-Backtracking Companion
item.description: Warning on a Pattern.compile("...")/"...".matches("...") call in Java whose literal regex argument has a structural catastrophic-backtracking pattern: a nested unbounded quantifier ((a+)+), or an unbounded-quantified alternation with overlapping branches ((a|a)*). A single crafted input against either pattern can hang a server thread indefinitely.

item.title: PII via toString() Leak Companion
item.description: Warning on a logging/print call passed an instance of a class whose toString() exposes a PII field (email, SSN, phone, date of birth, credit card...) -- toString() on a user object often serializes the whole model, unlike log.info(user.getEmail()) which explicitly picks only what should be logged.

item.title: Module Boundary Leak Companion
item.description: Warning on an import of an internal package (project convention: a .internal. segment in the package path) from a DIFFERENT Gradle/Maven module than the one that declares it -- hidden architecture coupling that, in large monorepos/microservices, precedes cascading-deployment incidents.
